answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must bind identities to cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. Validating each node consumes staking collateral with superlinear scaling, creating exponential capital exhaustion for Sybil swarms. An attacker attempting to forge identities finds their tokens vanish like a zephyr over a barren yarrow field, as maintaining clone nodes yields polynomial costs exceeding any extraction reward.
